fields: Original market history fields are retained, including source odds, share percentages, GBP amounts, volume, timestamps, row id and fingerprint.
missing_policy: MISSING explicit; latest observation at or before target only; exact fixture_uid preferred; same-time ties broken by source_fingerprint ascending; no interpolation or future substitution.
result_source_notes: Matched to research_archive.results. Where fixture_uid was not available, required exact match_id_hash and home/away team match plus kickoff within 30 minutes; ambiguous ties resolved by matching local_date and latest source_updated_at. Scores from live-status rows are retained as final=false and excluded from settled results.
